experiment.name: tmux_3_6a_idempotent_diagnostic_mutation_fence
experiment.hypothesis: The narrow idempotent tmux reapply predicate accepts only known already-removed key-table diagnostics plus benign line-boundary whitespace and rejects materially altered, mixed or unknown diagnostics.
experiment.counterhypothesis: A near-miss, mixed, prefixed/suffixed, control-character or randomly mutated diagnostic can cross the allowlist and convert an unknown tmux failure into an admitted reapply.
experiment.falsifier: Any materially non-exact diagnostic is accepted.

frontier: First actually-startable authorized isolated runner -> refresh main -> rejoin retained PR611 exactly once -> bind exact resulting head/blobs -> real tmux 3.6a idempotency/fail-closed discriminator -> focused + adjacent regressions -> promotion decision -> rejoin/revalidate PR602 -> native Claude/OCI/readiness/restart/concurrency gates.
nonclaims: No tmux binary was executed in this mutation experiment
